home.description: Dedicated absolute bridge directory, separate from DSH_HOME. No default.

publicUrl.description: Existing HTTPS origin without credentials, path or query. Owner may configure remote access in the companion; loopback waits without pairing until an address is selected.

relay.description: Optional administrator-configured default relay (wss:// origin). Empty keeps direct access; saved owner choices take precedence. Secret-required relays must be configured in the owner settings.

remoteMode.description: Initial remote mode; persisted owner selection takes precedence. Quick Tunnel never starts automatically.
